name: Depthwise3x3S8
adaptation: X is INT8 NHWC [1,4,4,2], index (4*h+w)*2+c. W has two independent 3x3 signed INT8 kernels, index (3*i+j)*2+c. Bias has two signed INT16 lanes. Y is signed INT32 NHWC [1,2,2,2], index (2*h+w)*2+c. Y[h,w,c]=bias[c]+sum(i=0..2,j=0..2,X[h+i,w+j,c]*W[i,j,c]). Stride one, valid padding, no cross-channel mixing, activation or requantization. All intermediates fit INT32; this is an integer grouped-convolution specialization.
